content: Swizzling against modern SDKs: hooks like hook_setRootViewController on UIWindow and _UIStaticScrollBar layoutSubviews depend on runtime classes/methods whose type encodings and behavior changed across iOS versions; rebuilding against a modern SDK with raised deployment target changes linked frameworks, dead-strips differently, and can alter type encodings (method_getTypeEncoding strcmp check in AutoHookImplementor silently skips hooks on mismatch). Private selectors referenced via categories (_hasSleepDisabler, _simulateTextEntered) and dlsym names (BKSDisplayBrightnessSet, SBGetScreenLockStatus, MRMediaRemoteGetNowPlayingInfo) persist as plaintext strings in the binary even after runtime-lookup indirection, and are detectable by App Review static scans. No live source verified; codebase analysis plus established ObjC runtime knowledge, MEDIUM confidence.
